03 / PUNERI AT HEART

आपला महाराष्ट्र

Maharashtra,
one plate at a time.

Born in Pune, fed by all of Maharashtra. From the Konkan coast to Vidarbha, every corner has its own plate, veg and non-veg. We’re inspired by all of it.

  1. 1PuneGhar. Home turf.Misal pav, bakarwadi & mastani
  2. 2MumbaiVada pav & pav bhaji
  3. 3KolhapurTambda-pandhra rassa
  4. 4Konkan · MalvanFish curry & solkadhi
  5. 5Nagpur · VidarbhaSaoji, the spicy one
  6. 6KhandeshJalgaon bharit & shev bhaji

Maharashtra’s food culture is our inspiration. These regional dishes are not our menu.
